wins: Maintained comprehensive reconnaissance coverage for the single episode, capturing port/service data before any major alerts (run_20260216_141650_d3861f_ep1_step8).
Instrumented targeted banner grabs on HTTP and SSH services to build situational awareness despite no successful mission completion.
fails: Failed to secure an exploit chain after initial access attempts, resulting in 0% success rate (run_20260216_141650_d3861f_ep1_step20).
Multiple credential-spray attempts hit lockout policies, preventing privilege escalation (run_20260216_141650_d3861f_ep1_step14).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough but follow-on exploitation failed due to credential lockouts and lack of a reliable privilege escalation vector.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Credential spray attempts triggered account lockouts before escalation could proceed

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to catalog available authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with a custom application banner containing 'Admin Console'
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke HTTP directory enumeration and submit form parameters to identify hidden management paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial foothold artifacts include outdated sudoers entries
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo privileges and craft minimal command to elevate without triggering alerts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH service is present
Consistent identification of hidden HTTP management paths improved situational awareness
